title: O Cancioneiro Portuguez da Vaticana: edição crítica restituída sobre o texto diplomático do manuscrito da Biblioteca Apostolica Vaticana, ed. Theophilo Braga (Lisbon, 1878)
period: 13th-15th century Galician-Portuguese lyric (cantigas de amor, de amigo and de escárnio), diplomatic transcription in an 1878 critical edition; the manuscript itself is 16th-century
license_note: Printed edition of 1878; editor Teófilo Braga (1843-1924), so public domain in the US (pre-1929 publication) and in the EU (70 years after the editor's death). The archive.org item cancioneiroportu00braguoft (University of Toronto copy) serves the full text openly with no login or paywall; the item page carries no access restriction on the text file.
